text:
nora_cs: Quick alert: APAC vector ingestion showing elevated failures for ~22 tenants (some in onboarding, a few enterprise trials). Ops says it's related to a quantized model routing change on the dedicated pools. Need customer comms + localized banners.

sam_ops: Confirmed. Root cause: misrouted traffic to a quantized runtime that doesn't support the new chunking format. We rolled a hotfix to routing at +12m; warm restart of the APAC pool underway. Expected stabilization in 20-30m.

priya_eng: TL;DR: ingestion pipeline accepts uploads but some batches are rejected with 422/503 depending on client retry. We have a temporary proxy that will accept the older chunk format and translate it to the new format. Proxy is live for 40% of traffic.

matt_support: Important for CS: will vector similarity/query return be affected? Also need recommended triage steps for customers hitting errors.

priya_eng: Retrieval unaffected for vectors already stored. Only ongoing uploads are impacted. Triage steps: (1) retry with exponential backoff, (2) use the temporary proxy endpoint (we'll provide link), (3) contact support with job-id. I'll post example curl snippets in a minute.

nora_cs: Drafting two outbound templates: (A) high-touch enterprise + renewal cohort; (B) bulk: trial and onboarding. Want to include: short explanation, mitigation steps, offer of 1.5x credit for failed ingestion, link to schedule an immediate troubleshooting session (30 min).

hana_l10n: I can do CN/JP/KO/EN-AU subjects & banner text. Please keep English subject <60 chars. I need final copy to start translations; turnaround ~90 mins for all locales.

incident-bot: incident-46000 created by sam_ops. Status: INVESTIGATING. Link: https://intra.redwood/incident/46000

matt_support: For in-console banner: propose: "APAC: temporary vector upload failures for some tenants. Mitigation in progress. See Support or schedule help." Keep it short.

nora_cs: Good. Also: which tenants are on renewals in next 45 days? We should prioritize outreach. Can we get a list filtered by renewal timer and onboarding status?

sam_ops: Pushing tenant list to /secure-share/cs/4600012345/affected-tenants.csv (access: cs-team). Includes flags: renewal_date, onboarding_stage, support_tier.

nora_cs: Perfect. I'll segment: Tier 1 renewals -> immediate 1:1 outreach, Tier 2 -> phased emails with optional office hours link. Trials -> bulk notice + self-serve proxy info.

priya_eng: Example curl for proxy (shareable):

```
curl -X POST https://proxy.apac.redwood/v1/vectors/upload \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \ 
  -F "file=@vectors.json" \ 
  -F "tenant_id=acct-123"
```

Use that until full roll completes.

matt_support: I'll create a Zendesk macro set: "apac-ingest-failed" + "offer-office-hours". Macro will include: scheduling link + credit confirmation text + FAQ.

hana_l10n: For banner translations, short variants: CN: "APAC：向量上传暂时失败，工程处理中"; JP: "APAC：ベクターのアップロードに障害が発生、対処中"; KO: "APAC: 벡터 업로드 일시 실패, 조치중". I'll refine after copy locked.

nora_cs: FAQ snippet please: "Was customer data exposed?" Add in all comms.

priya_eng: FAQ draft: "No customer data was exposed or modified. The issue affected the upload translation path only. Stored vectors remain intact. We will credit failed ingestion operations where applicable."

matt_support: One ask: flag accounts in Zendesk when email sent so support can see credit status easily. I'll add a ticket automation that adds internal note "ingest-credit-queued".

sam_ops: Hotfix completed at +12m; proxy covers 40% at +18m; full pool restart scheduled and started at +22m. Metrics: ingestion success rate rising from 60% -> 92% over the last 10m. I'll update when we hit >99% for 10m window.

nora_cs: Plan -> send Tier 1 high-touch now (use EN; hana will follow with localized subject lines later for non-EN tenants). Batch send Tier 2 in 2 hours after we confirm stabilization. Include scheduling link and credit offer.

hana_l10n: Note: for CN accounts we need legal-approved wording on credits. I'll work with legal if required; ETA 2 hours.

priya_eng: Final note: please include this troubleshooting notice in message body for engineers: "If you used chunking v2 and saw 422, retry via proxy endpoint or use the server-side SDK update (v1.4.2) that includes automatic fallback."

matt_support: I'll attach SDK upgrade link and changelog in macros.

incident-bot: incident-46000 status change: INVESTIGATING -> PARTIALLY_MITIGATED

nora_cs: Thanks all. I'll post the send log + per-tenant personalization tokens after the Tier 1 sends. Please ping here when you have the localized subjects so I can pause any scheduled sends for non-English accounts if needed. :pray:
